subject: Tufts Park Flood Mitigation and Redesign
overview: The Commission reviewed conceptual flood mitigation designs for Tufts Park and approved an expansion of the community garden. The body also finalized summer field permits and established a tournament fee for pickleball.

items.title: 2025 Park Permit Revenue
items.summary: Discussed lower revenue figures for park permits and tabled the matter until a direct comparison with previous years is available.

items.title: Community Preservation Act Revenue Report
items.summary: Graham reported that the city received $639,500 in CPA revenue for open space and recreation for the fiscal year.

items.title: Pickleball Tournament Policy
items.summary: Established a $25 daily fee for tournaments at Carr Park and restricted signage to small stakes in the turf.

items.title: Brooks Elementary PTO Donation
items.summary: Approved the donation of one pond pass and one pool pass for the school's spring event.

items.title: Tufts Park Conceptual Design
items.summary: Consultants presented preliminary designs for flood mitigation at Tufts Park involving underground storage and potential reorientation of the softball fields.

items.title: Garden Commission Expansion
items.summary: Approved adding 10 garden beds to Tufts Park and requested that future garden expansion requests be brought to the Commission before seeking funding.

items.title: Ultimate Frisbee Permit Coordination
items.summary: Approved field use at Morrison Park and Playstead Lower field for specified summer dates to avoid scheduling conflicts.

items.title: Seasonal Field Permit Approvals
items.summary: Approved summer permit requests for St. Raphael’s, Andre's Chiefs, Memorial Park, David Ferguson, and the Boston Ultimate Disc Alliance.

items.title: Barry Park Field Conflict
items.summary: Referred an Ultimate Frisbee request to staff to coordinate with Medford Youth Baseball regarding field availability at Barry Park.

items.title: United India Summer Fest
items.summary: Approved field use at Columbus Park on August 23 but denied a request for a bounce house due to city liability policies.
